the long wavelength emission in air-annealed films of fluorene- and carbazole-based electroluminecent blue materials is caused by the fluorenone of photo-oxidized fluorene, while the long wavelength emission after long-time operating organic light-emiting diodes (OLEDs) is caused by the excimer-related species of fluorene.
